description: Save an activity as a file on this machine and return its path: fit (original device file), gpx, tcx, kml or csv (laps). Use when the user wants the file itself, e.g. to import elsewhere.

output_dir.description: Subdirectory of the download directory (GARMIN_FIT_DOWNLOAD_DIR or <data dir>/downloads), e.g. "races"; default the download directory itself. Paths outside it are rejected
